title: Integrating Knowledge Graph with Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Vietnamese Legal Question Answering
relevance_reason: Directly addresses Vietnamese legal QA with knowledge graph-enhanced RAG and statutory hierarchy.
summary: A framework integrates an ontology-driven Knowledge Graph with Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Vietnamese legal QA, preserving statute hierarchy and encoding semantic/cross-reference relations. It uses graph-aware retrieval with hybrid ranking (semantic similarity + graph confidence) and a constrained prompting template for explicit citations. Evaluated on three law domains, it achieves 85.7% answer accuracy (vs. 62.3% BM25, 71.5% pure LLM) and improves citation quality, aiming to increase traceability by grounding generation in retrieved statutory provisions.

title: A Self-Reflection Mechanism for Reducing Hallucination in Vietnamese Legal Question Answering Systems
authors: Thi Vuong Pham; Nguyet Minh Phan; Bao Quynh Cao; Cong Phuc Truong; Thanh Duy Nguyen; Minh Vy Tien; Ngoc Son Nguyen
relevance_reason: 明确使用Graph-RAG管道处理越南劳动法问答，高度相关
summary: The paper proposes a self-reflection mechanism to reduce hallucinations in Vietnamese legal question-answering systems. It introduces an iterative generate-evaluate-refine loop built on a Graph-RAG pipeline, where each draft answer is scored using a hybrid measure combining contextual alignment with retrieved legal text and model confidence. The system iterates until a quality threshold or stopping limit is reached. On a Vietnamese Labor Law benchmark, the method improves accuracy from 81.5% to 86.7% and reduces hallucination from 18.7% to 9.3%, with minimal added latency. The study shows that pairing contextual alignment with confidence yields more stable results than either signal alone. The approach works without additional labeled data or fine-tuning and can be adapted to other Vietnamese legal domains requiring clause-level evidence.

title: Enhancing legal research through knowledge-infused information retrieval for Vietnamese labor law
authors: Vuong T. Pham; Hoang Huy Le; Thinh Phu Ngo; Binh T. Nguyen; Diem Nguyen; Hien D. Nguyen
relevance_reason: 涉及越南劳动法检索和知识注入，但未明确使用GraphRAG
summary: This research enhances legal document retrieval for Vietnamese labor law by using a dataset of 300,000 documents across 20 types and 27 legal fields, constructing a tailored Q&A dataset, and introducing a legal ontology built from the data to improve retrieval performance through knowledge infusion.
